platform: Windows x64, Abaqus 2025 HF1, Python 3.10.5 / NumPy 1.22.4
method: Five fresh processes per variant per fixture, sequential alternating order, complete saved baseline package versus current package. Same ODB bytes, instances, frames and PVD; bundled fixtures also export history. Imports/SDK startup and detailed instrumentation excluded from 50 primary timings. Cache build, rollover, copies and closure included. No cold-cache guarantee.
implementation: For multi-frame requests serialize Points and Cells once per export into one ASCII spool with a 1 MiB rollover threshold, then copy sections in 64 KiB chunks. Single-frame requests bypass storage. Cache is closed before PVD publication, including on failures. Source, mesh and field algorithms unchanged.
validation: Final output sets match byte-for-byte for all five selections; input hashes unchanged; thirteen VTU pairs checked with VTK. Memory/disk paths, CRLF policy, changing fields, request scope, single-frame bypass and failure cleanup covered by tests.
